document.abstract: The European Broadcasting Union (EBU) has had a very active year. The EBU has 70 members representing 116 organizations in 56 countries. These members provide services in television, radio, online, and hybrid platforms. Their interests are in all aspects of the broadcast services and also in running their operations, with respect to, for instance, business infrastructure and security.

authors.bio: Judy Parnall is the head of standards and industry on the Transformation Team at the British Broadcasting Corporation (BBC), London, U.K. In this role, she works on strategy input to standards and industry bodies across production, broadcast, and other media spheres on behalf of the BBC. She has worked at the BBC for a number of years in both R&D and corporate strategy areas. Her research interests have centered on the interaction of people with technology and services across all media. She has worked with the European Broadcasting Union (EBU) for over four years and has chaired the EBU’s Technical Committee since June 2018.
